title: RPL root vector metadata retains obsolete ULA and 02xx::/7 identity models
description: rpl_messages.json calls fd00::1 a LICHEN root DIO despite authenticated root AddrForKey binding, and root_signature.json describes Yggdrasil derivation as 02xx::/7 while current profile is 0200::/8. Correct metadata/examples, regenerate any derived expectations if needed, and add metadata/semantic assertions so consumers cannot treat ULA or the obsolete prefix rule as valid root identity.
